Ushiromiya George ({p:4:右代宮　譲治}){n}{n}Eva and Hideyoshi's son.{n}An affable young man liked by everyone in the family.{n}He is currently studying as an assistant for his father's company, and it seems he dreams of making it on his own one day.{n}{n}The oldest of the four cousins, he acts as their leader and arbitrator.

Ushiromiya George ({p:4:右代宮　譲治}){n}{n}Corpse discovered by the rose garden arbor.{n}There was a single hole right in the center of his forehead. It seems reasonable to think that he was shot with a gun or something.{n}{n}It was a brand of humiliation, marking his loss to Gaap.

Gohda Toshiro ({p:4:郷田　俊朗}){n}{n}Servant employed as a chef.{n}While he hasn't served the family long, he has a polished talent for entertaining guests, cultivated through his previous jobs, and is highly regarded as a servant.{n}{n}Since he was hired by Krauss and his wife, he is more trusted than those servants who have served the family longer and who are thought of as Kinzo's spies.

Gohda Toshiro ({p:4:郷田　俊朗}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the rose garden storehouse.{n}It is hypothesized that he was shot in the forehead and then strung up by his neck.{n}{n}They themselves put their necks in the nooses.{n}It was an interesting experience to try on occasion.

Ushiromiya Hideyoshi ({p:4:右代宮　秀吉}){n}{n}Eva's husband.{n}Took his wife's name upon their marriage and was welcomed into the Ushiromiya family.{n}Therefore, he does not possess the spiteful Ushiromiya genes, and his bright smile is very refreshing at the family conferences.{n}{n}He started his business from scratch, and now works as the president of a company operating medium‐sized restaurant chains.{n}Apparently business is soaring and things are going extremely well.

Ushiromiya Hideyoshi ({p:4:右代宮　秀吉}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the dining hall.{n}His head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that he was murdered with something like a powerful gun.{n}{n}However, the witnesses don't believe that he was killed with a gun...

Ushiromiya Jessica ({p:4:右代宮　朱志香}){n}{n}Krauss and Natsuhi's daughter.{n}In the absence of any irregularities, it is thought that she will eventually inherit the headship of the Ushiromiya family (or rather, her husband will). However, she seems to have no interest in all of this.{n}{n}Born with weak bronchi, and sometimes assailed by sudden asthma attacks.

Ushiromiya Jessica ({p:4:右代宮　朱志香}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in her own room on the second floor of the mansion.{n}Her head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that she was murdered with something like a powerful gun.{n}{n}Destroyed herself with her own strike with George's counterattacking‐type barrier.

Kanon ({p:4:嘉音}){n}{n}A young servant.{n}Performs his duties silently and diligently, but due to his unsociable nature, he is not so highly regarded as a servant.{n}{n}There are several other servants with the “on” ({p:4:音}) character in their pseudonyms.{n}He and Shannon just happened to be the ones on duty that day.

Kanon ({p:4:嘉音}){n}{n}Battler could not discover his corpse.{n}{n}Killing him with magic is all very well, but without a corpse, he will inevitably be a suspect.{n}Truly anti‐fantasy.{n}{n}{c:FF0000}Which is why I guaranteed his death with the red truth{/c}.{n}{n}Truly anti‐mystery...!

Ushiromiya Kinzo ({p:4:右代宮　金蔵}){n}{n}The aged head of the Ushiromiya family.{n}Brimming with energy, despite being pronounced to have only a short time left to live.{n}Amassed a vast fortune, but has never made any announcement about his inheritance, which worries his children.{n}{n}Strongly influenced by the West and a rabid fan of the occult.{n}His study is packed with mysterious grimoires.

Ushiromiya Kinzo ({p:4:右代宮　金蔵}){n}{n}Discovered as a burnt corpse from the incinerator in the underground boiler room.{n}{n}As there were no signs that he fought to get out of the incinerator, it seems reasonable to think that he was burned after he was murdered.{n}{n}Dust to dust. Ashes to ashes. The dead to the dead.

Ushiromiya Kyrie ({p:4:右代宮　霧江}){n}{n}Rudolf's second wife.{n}They had been business partners for a considerable length of time before the passing of his first wife, at which time she openly took the position.{n}{n}Served as Rudolf's right hand in several shady pieces of business, guiding them to success.{n}Quick‐thinking and deeply trusted by her husband.

Ushiromiya Kyrie ({p:4:右代宮　霧江}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in a guest room inside the mansion.{n}There was a single hole right in the center of her forehead. It seems reasonable to think that she was shot with a gun or something.{n}{n}A demon stake was rammed into her forehead, but it is difficult to imagine that this was the cause of death.{n}{n}I didn't {i}miss{/i}. I missed on purpose to torment her nyeh...!

Ushiromiya Krauss ({p:4:右代宮　蔵臼}){n}{n}Kinzo's first child.{n}Leads the family conference, as the eldest of the four siblings.{n}{n}However, the other siblings suspect that he plans to claim the entire family fortune for himself, and the antagonism between him and the others grows increasingly severe.{n}{n}A real estate investor, he has put a vast amount of money into the development of a resort.{n}However, his results have been harshly criticized.

Ushiromiya Krauss ({p:4:右代宮　蔵臼}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the vicinity of the mansion's back entrance.{n}His head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that he was murdered with something like a powerful gun.{n}{n}A demon stake was rammed into the destroyed portion of his head.{n}{n}None can escape the Chiesters' golden arrows.

Kumasawa Chiyo ({p:4:熊沢　チヨ}){n}{n}This elderly woman is a part‐timer who has served the family for a great many years, despite quitting her job several times along the way.{n}{n}Shrewd and more than competent when it comes to performing her duties, but because of her chattiness and love of rumors, she is not highly regarded as a servant.

Kumasawa Chiyo ({p:4:熊沢　チヨ}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the rose garden storehouse.{n}It is hypothesized that she was shot in the forehead and then strung up by her neck.{n}{n}As long as a locked room could be constructed, anything would have sufficed.

Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}){n}{n}Rosa's daughter. Her father's identity is unknown.{n}She can't shake off the habit of speaking like a young child, which often earns her a scolding.{n}{n}She has no interest in studying or making friends, but is very interested in things concerning the occult and black magic, and thanks to her excellent powers of memorization, she knows all kinds of obscure trivia.

Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the dining hall.{n}Unable to locate any notable external wounds, Battler speculated that it may have been some type of poisoning.{n}{n}The most peaceful method of inviting a person to the Golden Land.

Nanjo Terumasa ({p:4:南條　輝正}){n}{n}Kinzo's attending physician and long‐time friend.{n}Once ran a hospital on Niijima, but turned it over to his son, and now enjoys his old age in peace.{n}{n}One of the very few people that Kinzo trusts, now that he is held captive by an unrelenting suspicion of others.{n}Big‐hearted by nature, he has maintained a long friendship with Kinzo, unperturbed by his tendency to fly into a rage at the slightest provocation.

Nanjo Terumasa ({p:4:南條　輝正}){n}{n}Corpse discovered behind the mansion.{n}His head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that he was shot with a gun or something.{n}{n}A demon stake was lying next to the corpse.

Ushiromiya Natsuhi ({p:4:右代宮　夏妃}){n}{n}Krauss's wife.{n}Manages the household of the Ushiromiya head family in place of her husband, who takes little interest.{n}For this family conference, again, she was the one who took charge of making all the preparations and arrangements.{n}{n}Possesses a strong sense of responsibility and a great deal of pride.{n}However, neither her husband nor his siblings understand her very well, so her position is far from enviable.

Ushiromiya Natsuhi ({p:4:右代宮　夏妃}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the dining hall.{n}Her head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that she was murdered with something like a powerful gun.{n}{n}However, the witnesses don't believe that she was killed with a gun...

Ushiromiya Rosa ({p:4:右代宮　楼座}){n}{n}Kinzo's fourth child.{n}By far the youngest of the four siblings.{n}It seems that this gives her a weaker position at the family conference.{n}{n}She manages a design company, but she has yet to start taking it seriously, and its financial situation is far from favorable.

Ushiromiya Rosa ({p:4:右代宮　楼座}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the dining hall.{n}Her head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that she was murdered with something like a powerful gun.{n}{n}However, the witnesses don't believe that she was killed with a gun...

Ushiromiya Rudolf ({p:4:右代宮　留弗夫}){n}{n}Kinzo's third child.{n}Along with his sister, Eva, he intends to make his voice heard during the family conference to prevent their elder sibling, Krauss, from keeping all of their father's wealth for himself.{n}{n}Lost his former wife, Asumu ({p:4:明日夢}), six years ago, and married his current wife, Kyrie, straight after that.

Ushiromiya Rudolf ({p:4:右代宮　留弗夫}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the dining hall.{n}His head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that he was murdered with something like a powerful gun.{n}{n}However, the witnesses don't believe that he was killed with a gun...

Shannon ({p:4:紗音}){n}{n}A young but experienced servant.{n}She's normally calm and performs her job flawlessly, but she messes up when she gets nervous.{n}{n}Furthermore, “Shannon” is nothing more than a pseudonym that she uses when on duty, not her real name.

Shannon ({p:4:紗音}){n}{n}Corpse discovered behind the mansion.{n}Her head was half destroyed. It seems reasonable to think that she was shot with a gun or something.{n}{n}A demon stake was lying next to the corpse.{n}{n}The witnesses understand one thing at least: it was not the stake that killed her.

({p:4:ベアトリーチェ}){n}{n}The Endless Witch who has lived for a thousand years.{n}She is known for being exceptionally cruel, even among witches.{n}{n}She loves bullying the weak and is capable of using trial‐and‐error endlessly to find the cruelest fate they can possibly be given.{n}And she toys with her victims even further by piling on one after another.{n}{n}This witch is extremely powerful, but word has it that she sometimes becomes obsessed with the art of creating certain patterns, so that her means end up becoming her goals.

({p:4:ベアトリーチェ}){n}{n}The Endless Witch who has lived for a thousand years.{n}Possesses the fatherly magical power to grant endless evolution to the sea.{n}{n}However, that power is meaningless.{n}The sea of zero is nothing but zeroes, no matter how they are multiplied.{n}{n}But once 1 was miraculously born into that sea—her world became infinite.{n}{n}Once she was joined with the Witch of Origins in Mariage Sorcière, their system of magic obtained endless expansion and infinite power.

{f:5}Bernkastel{/f} ({p:4:ベルンカステル}) {n}{n}The Witch of Miracles who has lived for a thousand years.{n}Sent in a piece called {f:5}Ange{/f} to defeat {f:5}Beatrice{/f} in her game.{n}{n}The voyager witches who cross the sea of fragments are far higher‐level beings than witches who cannot leave their own territory.{n}{n}In‐territory they are equals, but fundamentally, her magic power far exceeds {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s.{n}{n}What is it that witches who voyage constantly in an escape from boredom seek from their journeys......?

({p:4:エンジェ}){n}{n}The Endless Witch who will live for the next thousand years.{n}Or, the witch hunter to slay all witches.{n}{n}Without understanding witches, one will never slay a witch.{n}After understanding witches, still never will one slay a witch.{n}{n}She understands witches—and denies them.{n}This contradictory power alone gives her the blade to slay witches.

Gaap ({p:4:ガァプ}){n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons. She is also {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s friend.{n}Grants the power of teleportation as the mage requests it.{n}{n}She uses this wonderful power only for pranks.{n}Her favorite trick is hiding keys and bags on busy mornings.{n}{n}However, this power of hers is an ultimate weapon that risks delivering the lethal blow to a locked‐room mystery.{n}Her queen‐bee‐like strikes would probably penetrate all famous detectives, and make them surrender.

The goats{n}{n}Low‐level furniture who wait on {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}They are many in number, but have no individuality, and rarely speak. They faithfully obey their master's orders.{n}{n}Closer in sensibility to animals than humans, they are surprisingly stupid, and occasionally get their orders wrong.{n}By nature, they have huge bodies like minotaurs, and possess incredible superhuman strength.{n}{n}They're low‐level as furniture, but the ability to summon them inexhaustibly is extremely useful.

{f:5}Goldsmith{/f} ({p:4:ゴールドスミス}){n}{n}Kinzo's name as a mage is {f:5}Goldsmith{/f}.{n}His skills as a summoner are legendary for the modern age.{n}In terms of summoning ability, there are times when he surpasses even {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}However, he is very mismatched, and while he does excel in some areas, he is fatally lacking as a mage in others.{n}{n}He cannot even perform the trifling magic to reheat a cup of tea, yet he can summon demons capable of using magic to boil the oceans.{n}{n}His system of magic is his own, and has its origins in mathematical miracles.{n}{f:5}Beatrice{/f} later reworked her own system of magic based on this.

{f:5}Lambdadelta{/f} ({p:4:ラムダデルタ}){n}{n}The Witch of Certainty who has lived for a thousand years.{n}She is using {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s game like a birdcage to imprison {f:5}Bernkastel{/f}.{n}Her objective is an eternal draw.{n}{n}Takes {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s side most of the time, but supports Battler when he looks like he's about to drop out.{n}{n}Conversely, when {f:5}Beatrice{/f} starts to get cornered, she supports {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}“Endless” is merely infinite idle repetition; “Certainty”, on the other hand, indicates a far stronger, absolute force of will...

Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}) {n}{n}A little mage who has inherited the black blood from Kinzo.{n}{n}Unlike Kinzo, she was gifted with natural talent, and began to tread the path of the mage while still young.{n}That said, her power is still weak, and she is no more than an apprentice.{n}{n}However, she is skilled with enchantments, which bestow magical power upon objects, and the magical items she creates compete with those of the Meister class.

({p:4:マリア}){n}{n}The Witch of Origins who will live for the next thousand years.{n}Possesses the motherly magical power to give birth to 1 from the sea of zero.{n}{n}At a glance, her magical power is weak.{n}However, 0 will never become anything but 0, no matter how it is multiplied.{n}But the 1 she gave birth to will eventually surpass the heavens.{n}{n}Protected heavily by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}, who understands her true value.{n}She is in an alliance with {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Eldest Sister, Lucifer ({p:4:ルシファー}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Lucifer is the eldest of the sisters, and by extension, also their leader.{n}{n}For that reason, she claims to be the strongest of the sisters, but is secretly aware that she is actually the least talented.{n}{n}However, she carries herself with pride every day in an attempt to hide this fact.{n}While living in terror of how she would be disparaged by her sisters if they ever found out.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Second Sister, Leviathan ({p:4:レヴィアタン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Leviathan often confronts the eldest sister Lucifer on behalf of the younger sisters.{n}{n}She has a fundamentally envious and brutal personality, and is adept at finding others' weaknesses.{n}{n}However, she is better described not as envious, but as a crybaby who wants her own way.{n}{n}For some reason, she is not very shrewd, and always ends up last in the sisters' order, drawing the short straw and crying.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Third Sister, Satan ({p:4:サタン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Satan takes on the role of the ever‐angry class president of the sisters.{n}{n}Diatribes tend to fly out of her mouth in rapid succession, so she is feared by the other sisters.{n}Because of this fear, no one is willing to talk back to her, and she is actually quite lonely.{n}{n}From time to time, she will intentionally do things so that she gets yelled at, but none of her sisters will admonish her for it, making her feel empty.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Fourth Sister, Belphegor ({p:4:ベルフェゴール}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Belphegor is taciturn, assiduous, and the most trusted of the sisters as furniture.{n}{n}However, that is partly because of her demonic desire to turn her masters into lazy pigs.{n}In that sense, she could probably be called the most demon‐like of all the sisters.{n}{n}Her flaw is that she is {i}too{/i} serious. Conversely, she is not used to being treated with kindness.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Fifth Sister, Mammon ({p:4:マモン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Mammon is extraordinarily quick to take what she wants, and she never holds back, not even for her sisters.{n}{n}Her motto is to be greedy and have things all to herself. For this reason, most arguments between the sisters are sparked and instigated by her.{n}{n}However, among the sisters, she is the most honest about her own emotions, and the most devoted to trying to please the opposite sex.{n}{n}Greedy but a hard worker, she will spare no effort to have a permanent monopoly on someone's affection.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Sixth Sister, Beelzebub ({p:4:ベルゼブブ}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Beelzebub is the gourmet of the sisters and is known for being a big and picky eater.{n}{n}Her personality is similar to Mammon's, and they often vie to beat each other to the prize.{n}{n}She's also always talking about food, which makes her a calming influence among the sisters.{n}{n}However, she also has a disturbing desire to kidnap pretty boys and store them in the food cellar...

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Seventh Sister, Asmodeus ({p:4:アスモデウス}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}As the youngest of the sisters, Asmodeus is doted upon by everyone.{n}This might be why she alone is kept out of the way when the conversation turns a little saucy.{n}{n}In the hopes that her older sisters will accept her as an adult, she is constantly on the lookout for a boyfriend.{n}{n}However, she sets her sights too high, and spends her days fantasizing about the prince who will never come.

Ronove ({p:4:ロノウェ}){n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons. Serves a master in exchange for various forms of compensation.{n}Presently has a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f} as her butler (head furniture).{n}{n}Has multiple underlings trained in housekeeping, and he himself is extremely capable as a butler.{n}{n}Employing him has become a kind of status in the high society of witches. Furthermore, the cookies he bakes are superb, and witches will often line up to demand them.{n}{n}Should possess enormous magical power, but as he always shows deference to his master, his power level is an unknown quantity.

Chiester{ruby}double‐oh{rb}00{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ００}){n}{n}A weapon of the Sisters' Cavalry, which serves Pendragon.{n}{n}00 has the position of their calm and composed leader.{n}However, that is merely the role that was sought of her; her true self is far more of a weakling.{n}{n}00 excels in reconnaissance and as a vanguard, and has enormous power to bring the enemy under control during encounters.{n}{n}However, her excessive power level has been criticized as inhumane, and it is not rare for her to be lynched and abused upon surrendering on the battlefield.{n}{n}Her one eye tells of this without words.

Chiester{ruby}four‐one‐zero{rb}410{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ４１０}){n}{n}A weapon in a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}410 is a kid with character, who has a unique and brazen way of speaking.{n}{n}Her hobby is teasing serious and uptight people, which is why she likes 45 and Lucifer.{n}{n}Rough‐spoken, but loves company and easily succumbs to loneliness.{n}Gets depressed unless there is someone constantly giving her attention.{n}{n}410 excels in firing control, and even in close‐range combat, exhibits battle power that is second to none.

Chiester{ruby}forty‐five{rb}45{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ４５}){n}{n}A weapon in a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}45 has an extremely meticulous and timid personality, and is fairly paranoid.{n}For that reason, she compensates well for the weaknesses of 410's slapdash personality when they work as a pair.{n}{n}Cannot bear silence, and even becomes emotionally unstable unless she is constantly being given orders.{n}{n}45 excels in enemy search and being decisive. The sisters' battle power is doubled by her support.

Chiester{ruby}five‐five‐six{rb}556{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ５５６}){n}{n}A quiet girl who is always being teased by everyone.{n}But that is because they all love her very much.{n}{n}The trumpet is her specialty.{n}Everyone skips to her lively tone.

Chiester{ruby}five‐five‐six{rb}556{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ５５６}){n}{n}A weapon of the Sisters' Cavalry, which serves Pendragon.{n}{n}Although 556 was a quiet girl who was always being teased, she was loved by everybody.{n}However, luck was not on her side, and she suffered a brutal death in a battle with the black witch.{n}{n}She was a state-of-the-art weapon, and added color to the Sisters' Cavalry, which had the strong flavor of an honor guard.{n}{n}556 was in charge of squad fire support.{n}She shot not to kill, but to protect her allies.

Sakutarou ({p:4:さくたろう}){n}{n}Beloved furniture of Lady {f:5}Maria{/f}, witch of Mariage Sorcière.{n}{n}His existence is Lady {f:5}Maria{/f}'s pure white heart itself.{n}He is an irreplaceable being to her, and could even be said to be another Lady {f:5}Maria{/f}.{n}{n}He holds a decoration as a diplomat, and all witches, weapons, and furniture in the alliance, and even demons and divine spirits in contract with the alliance, are not permitted to take aim at him.

Sakutarou ({p:4:さくたろう}){n}{n}Lady {f:5}Maria{/f}'s pure white heart, torn asunder.{n}{n}His broken vessel can only be regenerated by {f:5}Rosa{/f}, the Meister who made him.{n}{n}However, {f:5}Rosa{/f} disposed of all the vessel's scraps, and even lost the sewing pattern.{n}On top of this, because his existence was denied by the Meister herself, resurrecting him is impossible.{n}{n}With the Meister's death in 1986, his resurrection was lost forever.{n}{n}Resurrecting him is impossible even for the Endless Witch, {f:5}Beatrice{/f}......

({p:4:ワルギリア}){n}{n}Retired Endless Witch, and {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s master.{n}Made proper use of the Endless Magic, and dedicated her life to the happiness and smiles of people.{n}{n}Taught {f:5}Beatrice{/f} the Endless Magic, and retired believing that {f:5}Beatrice{/f} would devote herself to people in the same way.{n}{n}As well as being {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s master, she was also the consulting mage of {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s old home.{n}For this reason, {f:5}Virgilia{/f} interacted with her in the manner of a servant.{n}It is said that this was responsible for causing {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s egotism and excesses.

Amakusa Juuza ({p:4:天草　十三}){n}{n}A former guard of Eva's.{n}An extreme thrillseeker who accepts dangerous jobs for little pay.{n}{n}He had served as Ange's bodyguard before, but after he broke Eva's strict order not to talk to Ange countless times, Eva ultimately took a dislike to him and let him go.{n}{n}Ange herself didn't find him all that bad, because he was someone she could talk to.{n}{n}JSDF, Foreign Legion, private military companies—this man has traveled them all, and has skill in counter‐sniping and escorting VIPs.

{f:5}Bernkastel{/f} ({p:4:ベルンカステル}){n}{n}The Witch of Miracles who has lived for a thousand years.{n}Her vast power is capable of creating all kinds of miracles, but her heart has broken a bit as a result.{n}{n}Back when she was a human, {f:5}Lambdadelta{/f} once imprisoned her within a cruel fate, toying with her the whole time.{n}It seems that she's unable to abandon others who are caught within a similar fate.{n}{n}In theory, she holds the strongest power of any witch, but in practice, that is no more realistic than saying that a piece of paper can reach the moon if you fold it a hundred times.{n}{n}And fold it a hundred times she did.

Ushiromiya Ange ({p:4:右代宮　縁寿}){n}{n}Threw herself off the top of a skyscraper and miraculously survived unharmed.{n}Her mystical experience led her to abandon everything and go on a personal journey to discover her past.{n}{n}Will she, positioned twelve years in the future, be able to break through {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s magical power...?

Ushiromiya Eva ({p:4:右代宮　絵羽}){n}{n}After being repeatedly hospitalized from psychogenic stress, she is already dead in the world of 1998 due to acute heart failure.{n}{n}The only survivor from Rokkenjima, she lived her later years in isolation with no one to understand her. The media gave her the name “Queen Of Suspicion”.{n}{n}She continued on a path of reckless expansion like Kinzo had done in the past, and made many enemies.{n}{n}In her later years, she seemed to do this repeatedly as if she found it funny, and at that point it was no longer for economic reasons, but simply to harass.{n}{n}And all of this was for the sake of Ange, who would eventually succeed her.

Sumadera Kasumi ({p:4:須磨寺　霞}){n}{n}Daughter of the declining noble family Sumadera. Ushiromiya Kyrie's younger sister.{n}{n}She hates her sister Kyrie so much that she loathes everything about her, so she also strongly hates Ange.{n}{n}She is the opposite of the freewheeling person Kyrie was, and holds appearances in high regard, possessing a strong ambition for philanthropy.{n}However, that is nothing more than a manifestation of her complex towards her sister, causing her to crave the limelight.{n}{n}There are several opposing factions in the Sumadera family, and they are constantly engaged in a secret feud over who will control the vast wealth Ange holds.

Captain Kawabata ({p:4:川畑船長}){n}{n}An old man who used to captain the high‐speed boat that went to Rokkenjima and back.{n}{n}It is beyond doubt that of the existing survivors, he is one of those who know the most about Rokkenjima.{n}{n}From various comments by the servants who used to go to and from the island, the media hoped that he might be quite knowledgeable about the internal affairs of the Ushiromiya family.{n}{n}However, he would say nothing, and so they eventually began to forget about this old man...

({p:4:マリア}){n}{n}The Witch of Origins who will live for the next thousand years.{n}Possesses the motherly magical power to give birth to 1 from the sea of zero.{n}{n}At a glance, her magical power is weak.{n}However, 0 will never become anything but 0, no matter how it is multiplied.{n}But the 1 she gave birth to will eventually surpass the heavens.{n}{n}Protected heavily by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}, who understands her true value.{n}She is in an alliance with {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.

Nanjo Masayuki ({p:4:南條　雅行}){n}{n}Nanjo's son. Took over the Nanjo Clinic.{n}Unlike Nanjo, he gives a slightly dispassionate, indifferent impression.{n}{n}After the commotion surrounding Rokkenjima, he grew to completely despise the press, and never again did he attempt to speak of what had happened at the time.{n}{n}He used to have a daughter who was afflicted with an intractable disease, but unfortunately, she wasn't able to live out her natural lifespan.

Okonogi Tetsuro ({p:4:小此木　鉄郎}){n}{n}A major player in the Ushiromiya Group.{n}After Eva's death and until Ange succeeds the group, he and the other ministers are the ones managing it.{n}{n}However, since Ange has no desire to do so, the group is on the brink of internal discord, putting him in a difficult position as well.{n}{n}He was previously the president of a foodstuff distribution company, and had a very close relationship with Hideyoshi's company.{n}{n}Because of that long‐lasting association, Eva particularly trusted him, and he was appointed to a significant post in the group.

Professor Ootsuki ({p:4:大月教授}){n}{n}A professor at a certain college, well‐known as an authority on the study of Western folklore.{n}{n}Also famous as a hobbyist researcher of the Rokkenjima Witch Legend and as one of the Witch Hunters.{n}{n}The Witch Hunt is primarily focused on the straining of occult superstitions to explain the truth of the Rokkenjima crime rather than doing so scientifically, and its dilettantes and enthusiasts of the mystical primarily view it as a type of mental game.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Eldest Sister, Lucifer ({p:4:ルシファー}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Lucifer is the eldest of the sisters, and by extension, also their leader.{n}{n}For that reason, she claims to be the strongest of the sisters, but is secretly aware that she is actually the least talented.{n}{n}However, she carries herself with pride every day in an attempt to hide this fact.{n}While living in terror of how she would be disparaged by her sisters if they ever found out.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Second Sister, Leviathan ({p:4:レヴィアタン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Leviathan often confronts the eldest sister Lucifer on behalf of the younger sisters.{n}{n}She has a fundamentally envious and brutal personality, and is adept at finding others' weaknesses.{n}{n}However, she is better described not as envious, but as a crybaby who wants her own way.{n}{n}For some reason, she is not very shrewd, and always ends up last in the sisters' order, drawing the short straw and crying.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Third Sister, Satan ({p:4:サタン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Satan takes on the role of the ever‐angry class president of the sisters.{n}{n}Diatribes tend to fly out of her mouth in rapid succession, so she is feared by the other sisters.{n}Because of this fear, no one is willing to talk back to her, and she is actually quite lonely.{n}{n}From time to time, she will intentionally do things so that she gets yelled at, but none of her sisters will admonish her for it, making her feel empty.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Fourth Sister, Belphegor ({p:4:ベルフェゴール}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Belphegor is taciturn, assiduous, and the most trusted of the sisters as furniture.{n}{n}However, that is partly because of her demonic desire to turn her masters into lazy pigs.{n}In that sense, she could probably be called the most demon‐like of all the sisters.{n}{n}Her flaw is that she is {i}too{/i} serious. Conversely, she is not used to being treated with kindness.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Fifth Sister, Mammon ({p:4:マモン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Mammon is the piece of furniture who was the first to become Ange's friend.{n}{n}She remained alongside her throughout her years of training, supporting her master constantly and greedily so that she could become a full‐fledged witch.{n}{n}A special person, even among the seven sisters.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Sixth Sister, Beelzebub ({p:4:ベルゼブブ}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Beelzebub is the gourmet of the sisters and is known for being a big and picky eater.{n}{n}Her personality is similar to Mammon's, and they often vie to beat each other to the prize.{n}{n}She's also always talking about food, which makes her a calming influence among the sisters.{n}{n}However, she also has a disturbing desire to kidnap pretty boys and store them in the food cellar...

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Seventh Sister, Asmodeus ({p:4:アスモデウス}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}As the youngest of the sisters, Asmodeus is doted upon by everyone.{n}This might be why she alone is kept out of the way when the conversation turns a little saucy.{n}{n}In the hopes that her older sisters will accept her as an adult, she is constantly on the lookout for a boyfriend.{n}{n}However, she sets her sights too high, and spends her days fantasizing about the prince who will never come.

Kumasawa Sabakichi ({p:4:熊沢　鯖吉}){n}{n}Kumasawa's son. Works at the Niijima Fishing Harbor.{n}He must have gotten his carefree, big‐hearted personality from Kumasawa.{n}{n}Kumasawa had many sons, and a number of them were away from land as fishermen.{n}It was purely coincidence that it was possible to come into contact with him, as he happened to be involved with the fishing harbor.{n}{n}Hopes are on him that he might have heard chatty Kumasawa let something important slip, but...
Sakutarou ({p:4:さくたろう}){n}{n}Maria onee‐chan's precious friend.{n}Very simple, warm, and kind.{n}{n}His speech quirk is “uryu”.{n}{n}I remember Maria onee‐chan used to say it a lot, too.

Ushiromiya Battler ({p:4:右代宮　戦人}){n}{n}The son of Rudolf and his first wife, Asumu.{n}Turned against his father six years ago when he married a second wife immediately after Asumu passed on.{n}He went to live with his grandparents on his mother's side.{n}However, both of these grandparents passed away, and he has now returned to the Ushiromiya family after six years.{n}{n}This family conference is a chance for him to renew his friendship with his cousins after a six‐year gap.

Ushiromiya Eva ({p:4:右代宮　絵羽}){n}{n}Kinzo's second child.{n}Hostile towards her brother Krauss and opposes him in almost everything, from issues dealing with the family fortune to the question of who will succeed the family headship.{n}{n}Normally, she would have lost her place in the Ushiromiya register upon her marriage, but she managed to forcibly overcome this by having her husband take her family name.

Ronoue Genji ({p:4:呂ノ上　源氏}){n}{n}Head servant, leading all the other servants who work for the Ushiromiya family.{n}Has served Kinzo longer than any other, and has earned his greatest trust.{n}{n}Since he serves Kinzo directly, Krauss and Natsuhi think of him as Kinzo's spy.

Ronoue Genji ({p:4:呂ノ上　源氏}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the servants' quarters on the first floor of the mansion.{n}{n}The direct cause of death is unknown, but his neck has been sliced open by a sharp blade.{n}The wound is deep enough that anyone could easily confirm his death with absolute certainty.

Ushiromiya George ({p:4:右代宮　譲治}){n}{n}Eva and Hideyoshi's son.{n}An affable young man liked by everyone in the family.{n}He is currently studying as an assistant for his father's company, and it seems he dreams of making it on his own one day.{n}{n}The oldest of the four cousins, he acts as their leader and arbitrator.

Ushiromiya George ({p:4:右代宮　譲治}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the cousins' room on the upper floor of the guesthouse.{n}{n}The direct cause of death is unknown, but his neck was sliced open by a sharp blade.{n}The wound was deep enough that anyone could easily confirm his death with absolute certainty.

Gohda Toshiro ({p:4:郷田　俊朗}){n}{n}Servant employed as a chef.{n}While he hasn't served the family long, he has a polished talent for entertaining guests, cultivated through his previous jobs, and is highly regarded as a servant.{n}{n}Since he was hired by Krauss and his wife, he is more trusted than those servants who have served the family longer and who are thought of as Kinzo's spies.

Ushiromiya Hideyoshi ({p:4:右代宮　秀吉}){n}{n}Eva's husband.{n}Took his wife's name upon their marriage and was welcomed into the Ushiromiya family.{n}Therefore, he does not possess the spiteful Ushiromiya genes, and his bright smile is very refreshing at the family conferences.{n}{n}He started his business from scratch, and now works as the president of a company operating medium‐sized restaurant chains.{n}Apparently business is soaring and things are going extremely well.

Ushiromiya Hideyoshi ({p:4:右代宮　秀吉}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in a guest room on the first floor of the mansion.{n}{n}He had been pierced through the back with a demon stake.{n}Its tip reached as far as his lungs.{n}{n}Because he was lying face-down on the bed, suicide must be ruled out.

Ushiromiya Jessica ({p:4:右代宮　朱志香}){n}{n}Krauss and Natsuhi's daughter.{n}In the absence of any irregularities, it is thought that she will eventually inherit the headship of the Ushiromiya family (or rather, her husband will). However, she seems to have no interest in all of this.{n}{n}Born with weak bronchi, and sometimes assailed by sudden asthma attacks.

Ushiromiya Jessica ({p:4:右代宮　朱志香}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the cousins' room on the upper floor of the guesthouse.{n}{n}The direct cause of death is unknown, but her neck was sliced open by a sharp blade.{n}The wound was deep enough that anyone could easily confirm her death with absolute certainty.

Kanon ({p:4:嘉音}){n}{n}A young servant.{n}Performs his duties silently and diligently, but due to his unsociable nature, he is not so highly regarded as a servant.{n}{n}There are several other servants with the “on” ({p:4:音}) character in their pseudonyms.{n}He and Shannon just happened to be the ones on duty that day.

Ushiromiya Kinzo ({p:4:右代宮　金蔵}){n}{n}The aged head of the Ushiromiya family.{n}Brimming with energy, despite being pronounced to have only a short time left to live.{n}Amassed a vast fortune, but has never made any announcement about his inheritance, which worries his children.{n}{n}Strongly influenced by the West and a rabid fan of the occult.{n}His study is packed with mysterious grimoires.

Ushiromiya Kyrie ({p:4:右代宮　霧江}){n}{n}Rudolf's second wife.{n}They had been business partners for a considerable length of time before the passing of his first wife, at which time she openly took the position.{n}{n}Served as Rudolf's right hand in several shady pieces of business, guiding them to success.{n}Quick‐thinking and deeply trusted by her husband.

Ushiromiya Krauss ({p:4:右代宮　蔵臼}){n}{n}Kinzo's first child.{n}Leads the family conference, as the eldest of the four siblings.{n}{n}However, the other siblings suspect that he plans to claim the entire family fortune for himself, and the antagonism between him and the others grows increasingly severe.{n}{n}A real estate investor, he has put a vast amount of money into the development of a resort.{n}However, his results have been harshly criticized.

Ushiromiya Krauss ({p:4:右代宮　蔵臼}){n}{n}Went missing from his room on the second floor of the mansion.{n}There were large amounts of blood on the bed, making the situation bear a strong resemblance to those of the other victims.{n}He is the only victim of the first twilight whose body was never witnessed.

Ushiromiya Krauss ({p:4:右代宮　蔵臼}){n}{n}Murdered sometime after the early morning phone call by which Natsuhi learned that he was still alive.{n}His corpse has not been found, but his death has been guaranteed by {f:5}Bernkastel{/f} with the red truth.

Kumasawa Chiyo ({p:4:熊沢　チヨ}){n}{n}This elderly woman is a part‐timer who has served the family for a great many years, despite quitting her job several times along the way.{n}{n}Shrewd and more than competent when it comes to performing her duties, but because of her chattiness and love of rumors, she is not highly regarded as a servant.

Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}){n}{n}Rosa's daughter. Her father's identity is unknown.{n}She can't shake off the habit of speaking like a young child, which often earns her a scolding.{n}{n}She has no interest in studying or making friends, but is very interested in things concerning the occult and black magic, and thanks to her excellent powers of memorization, she knows all kinds of obscure trivia.

Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}) {n}{n}Corpse discovered in the cousins' room on the upper floor of the guesthouse.{n}{n}The direct cause of death is unknown, but her neck was sliced open by a sharp blade.{n}The wound was deep enough that anyone could easily confirm her death with absolute certainty.

Nanjo Terumasa ({p:4:南條　輝正}){n}{n}Kinzo's attending physician and long‐time friend.{n}Once ran a hospital on Niijima, but turned it over to his son, and now enjoys his old age in peace.{n}{n}One of the very few people that Kinzo trusts, now that he is held captive by an unrelenting suspicion of others.{n}Big‐hearted by nature, he has maintained a long friendship with Kinzo, unperturbed by his tendency to fly into a rage at the slightest provocation.

Ushiromiya Natsuhi ({p:4:右代宮　夏妃}){n}{n}Krauss's wife.{n}Manages the household of the Ushiromiya head family in place of her husband, who takes little interest.{n}For this family conference, again, she was the one who took charge of making all the preparations and arrangements.{n}{n}Possesses a strong sense of responsibility and a great deal of pride.{n}However, neither her husband nor his siblings understand her very well, so her position is far from enviable.

Ushiromiya Rosa ({p:4:右代宮　楼座}){n}{n}Kinzo's fourth child.{n}By far the youngest of the four siblings.{n}It seems that this gives her a weaker position at the family conference.{n}{n}She manages a design company, but she has yet to start taking it seriously, and its financial situation is far from favorable.

Ushiromiya Rosa ({p:4:右代宮　楼座}) {n}{n}Corpse discovered in the cousins' room on the upper floor of the guesthouse.{n}{n}The direct cause of death is unknown, but her neck was sliced open by a sharp blade.{n}The wound was deep enough that anyone could easily confirm her death with absolute certainty.

Ushiromiya Rudolf ({p:4:右代宮　留弗夫}){n}{n}Kinzo's third child.{n}Along with his sister, Eva, he intends to make his voice heard during the family conference to prevent their elder sibling, Krauss, from keeping all of their father's wealth for himself.{n}{n}Lost his former wife, Asumu ({p:4:明日夢}), six years ago, and married his current wife, Kyrie, straight after that.

Shannon ({p:4:紗音}){n}{n}A young but experienced servant.{n}She's normally calm and performs her job flawlessly, but she messes up when she gets nervous.{n}{n}Furthermore, “Shannon” is nothing more than a pseudonym that she uses when on duty, not her real name.

Furudo Erika ({p:4:古戸　ヱリカ}){n}{n}Fell from the pleasure boat “Eternal Maid II” mid-cruise in the waters near Rokkenjima.{n}{n}She washed up on Rokkenjima on October 4th, 1986.{n}The Ushiromiya family welcomed her as a guest.{n}{n}She managed to drift to the island unharmed thanks to several miracles, including the life jacket she was wearing.

{f:5}Bernkastel{/f} ({p:4:ベルンカステル}){n}{n}The Witch of Miracles.{n}Also known as “the witch who knows that miracles don't occur”.{n}{n}Participates in the fifth game as the player opposing Beato.{n}However, from the very beginning, her aim has been to deny the witch illusion.{n}Her only goal is to destroy Beato and her world as a way to stave off boredom...{n}{n}Though she does deny the witch illusion, she is no ally of Battler's.

Dlanor A. Knox ({p:4:ドラノール・Ａ・ノックス}){n}{n}A member of Eiserne Jungfrau, the Seventh District Repentance Enforcement Agency of the Great Court of Heaven.{n}Chief Inquisitor. Ranked Archbishop, First Class.{n}Goes by the name “Dlanor of the Ten Wedges” or “Death Sentence Dlanor”.{n}{n}She gets the name “Death Sentence” because, though Inquisitors normally judge their targets to determine whether they deserve the death penalty or not, Dlanor, as the Chief Inquisitor, is only dispatched after a case has been vigorously inspected by the Great Court. Therefore, the very act of dispatching her is equivalent to a death sentence.{n}{n}Her father was a legendary Inquisitor, but he broke the rules and was executed.{n}She was the one who interrogated and executed him.{n}Since that time, she has stopped growing, and both her body and mind remain eternally those of a young girl.{n}It is whispered that her heart also died at that moment, but she does not see it that way.{n}{n}Her primary weapons are the Conceptual Arms “Red Key” and “Blue Key”.{n}They take the form of a longsword and a shortsword.

({p:4:ベアトリーチェ}){n}{n}The Golden Witch and the Endless Witch.{n}Beato's piece, who represents the witch illusion.{n}Claims that the entire incident on Rokkenjima was caused by the witch illusion.{n}In the fifth game, she clashes with {f:5}Bernkastel{/f} who denies this.{n}{n}Because she is no more than a piece and the higher-plane version of her has withdrawn from being the Game Master, she is not in a position to know the truth behind the fifth game.{n}This means she is in a different position than the one she held in previous games.

({p:4:ベアトリーチェ}){n}{n}The {f:5}Beatrice{/f} on the highest plane and the one who created this world.{n}Entrusted everything to Battler during the fourth game and gave up the position of Game Master.{n}She has lost not only the will to fight, but even the will to express herself, and is now little more than a doll...{n}{n}In the world of the game board, those who do not fight have no meaning.{n}Her existence is gradually losing its value and will probably break down and disappear before too long...

{f:5}Lambdadelta{/f} ({p:4:ラムダデルタ}){n}{n}Serving as the fifth game's Game Master in place of Beato, who stepped down from the position in the fourth game.{n}Because of that, the story of the fifth game, while appearing very similar to previous games, is expected to turn out quite differently...{n}{n}Just like {f:5}Bernkastel{/f}, she has no love for boredom, and might be friend or foe to Beato or Bern depending on the situation.

({p:4:ワルギリア}){n}{n}Retired Endless Witch, and {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s master.{n}Made proper use of the Endless Magic, and dedicated her life to the happiness and smiles of people.{n}{n}Taught {f:5}Beatrice{/f} the Endless Magic, and retired believing that {f:5}Beatrice{/f} would devote herself to people in the same way.{n}{n}As well as being {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s master, she was also the consulting mage of {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s old home.{n}For this reason, {f:5}Virgilia{/f} interacted with her in the manner of a servant.{n}It is said that this was responsible for causing {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s egotism and excesses.

Ronove ({p:4:ロノウェ}){n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons. Serves a master in exchange for various forms of compensation.{n}Presently has a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f} as her butler (head furniture).{n}{n}Has multiple underlings trained in housekeeping, and he himself is extremely capable as a butler.{n}{n}Employing him has become a kind of status in the high society of witches. Furthermore, the cookies he bakes are superb, and witches will often line up to demand them.{n}{n}Should possess enormous magical power, but as he always shows deference to his master, his power level is an unknown quantity.

Gaap ({p:4:ガァプ}){n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons. She is also {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s friend.{n}Grants the power of teleportation as the mage requests it.{n}{n}She uses this wonderful power only for pranks.{n}Her favorite trick is hiding keys and bags on busy mornings.{n}{n}However, this power of hers is an ultimate weapon that risks delivering the lethal blow to a locked‐room mystery.{n}Her queen‐bee‐like strikes would probably penetrate all famous detectives, and make them surrender.

Furudo Erika ({p:4:古戸　ヱリカ}){n}{n}{f:5}Bernkastel{/f}'s double and servant. Also a piece who has manifested in the {y:0}Human{/y}{n:0}human{/n} world.{n}{n}Because she is {y:0}Human{/y}{n:0}human{/n}, she cannot use magic and the like.{n}However, because she is in contact with {f:5}Bernkastel{/f} in a higher world and can appeal to her to use higher-world miracles and authority on her behalf, it would probably be no exaggeration to call Furudo Erika a {y:0}Human{/y}{n:0}human{/n} capable of wielding the power of a witch.{n}{n}Through {f:5}Bernkastel{/f}, she has been given the detective's authority while on the game board.{n}{n}Therefore, even though she is an outsider to the Ushiromiya family, she possesses the right to demand full attention from everyone when speaking, the right to advance proceedings, and the right to investigate the crime scene before the police arrive, as well as many other special abilities.{n}{n}She gets pleasure from the process of solving riddles, but her greatest joy comes from using that victory to sneer at others.

Gertrude ({p:4:ガートルード}){n}{n}A member of Eiserne Jungfrau, the Seventh District Repentance Enforcement Agency of the Great Court of Heaven.{n}Senior Assistant Inquisitor. Ranked Minister, First Class.{n}{n}As an Assistant Inquisitor, she is tasked with aiding during interrogations and hearings.{n}{n}In practice, execution ends up being the primary focus of most missions, and so she is usually assigned the job of using barriers to block the target's means of escape.{n}{n}On duty, she is calm, flawless, expressionless, and emotionless; however, in truth, she is quite compassionate and is loved by many of her juniors.{n}{n}She has already passed the exam to become a full Inquisitor and was offered a position in a different district, but she refused.{n}She continues to serve alongside Dlanor, to whom she owes a great debt, waiting for a reassignment under her.{n}Therefore, though she is an assistant, she is treated as an Inquisitor (Archbishop, Third Class).

Cornelia ({p:4:コーネリア}){n}{n}A member of Eiserne Jungfrau, the Seventh District Repentance Enforcement Agency of the Great Court of Heaven.{n}Assistant Inquisitor, ranked Minister, Third Class.{n}{n}She has obtained high grades in academic exercises, but this is her first time on the job.{n}She possesses a strong sense of justice, and is currently cramming for exams to become an Inquisitor like Dlanor.{n}Her current goal is to become more like the veteran assistant, Gertrude.{n}{n}She actually has a zealous personality, but she pretends to be emotionless in imitation of Gertrude.{n}{n}She is too innocent and pure for one connected to heresy hearings, and she knows nothing of the dirty jobs and dark side of the profession.{n}{n}Gertrude intentionally selected her for this mission, which stinks of Senate conspiracy.{n}She did this to give Cornelia a chance to ask herself whether this sort of job really is the right one for her.

Ushiromiya Battler ({p:4:右代宮　戦人}){n}{n}The man designated by Beato as her opponent during the first four games.{n}Disgusted at how {f:5}Lambdadelta{/f} took over as Game Master for the fifth game, he is not taking part in it as a player.

Chiester{ruby}forty‐five{rb}45{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ４５}){n}{n}A weapon in a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}45 has an extremely meticulous and timid personality, and is fairly paranoid.{n}For that reason, she compensates well for the weaknesses of 410's slapdash personality when they work as a pair.{n}{n}Cannot bear silence, and even becomes emotionally unstable unless she is constantly being given orders.{n}{n}45 excels in enemy search and being decisive. The sisters' battle power is doubled by her support.

Chiester{ruby}four‐one‐zero{rb}410{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ４１０}){n}{n}A weapon in a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}410 is a kid with character, who has a unique and brazen way of speaking.{n}{n}Her hobby is teasing serious and uptight people, which is why she likes 45 and Lucifer.{n}{n}Rough‐spoken, but loves company and easily succumbs to loneliness.{n}Gets depressed unless there is someone constantly giving her attention.{n}{n}410 excels in firing control, and even in close‐range combat, exhibits battle power that is second to none.

Chiester{ruby}double‐oh{rb}00{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ００}){n}{n}A weapon of the Sisters' Cavalry, which serves Pendragon.{n}{n}00 has the position of their calm and composed leader.{n}However, that is merely the role that was sought of her; her true self is far more of a weakling.{n}{n}00 excels in reconnaissance and as a vanguard, and has enormous power to bring the enemy under control during encounters.{n}{n}However, her excessive power level has been criticized as inhumane, and it is not rare for her to be lynched and abused upon surrendering on the battlefield.{n}{n}Her one eye tells of this without words.

Chiester{ruby}five‐five‐six{rb}556{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ５５６}){n}{n}A quiet girl who is always being teased by everyone.{n}But that is because they all love her very much.{n}{n}The trumpet is her specialty.{n}Everyone skips to her lively tone.

Chiester{ruby}five‐five‐six{rb}556{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ５５６}){n}{n}A weapon of the Sisters' Cavalry, which serves Pendragon.{n}{n}Although 556 was a quiet girl who was always being teased, she was loved by everybody.{n}However, luck was not on her side, and she suffered a brutal death in a battle with the black witch.{n}{n}She was a state-of-the-art weapon, and added color to the Sisters' Cavalry, which had the strong flavor of an honor guard.{n}{n}556 was in charge of squad fire support.{n}She shot not to kill, but to protect her allies.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Eldest Sister, Lucifer ({p:4:ルシファー}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Lucifer is the eldest of the sisters, and by extension, also their leader.{n}{n}For that reason, she claims to be the strongest of the sisters, but is secretly aware that she is actually the least talented.{n}{n}However, she carries herself with pride every day in an attempt to hide this fact.{n}While living in terror of how she would be disparaged by her sisters if they ever found out.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Second Sister, Leviathan ({p:4:レヴィアタン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Leviathan often confronts the eldest sister Lucifer on behalf of the younger sisters.{n}{n}She has a fundamentally envious and brutal personality, and is adept at finding others' weaknesses.{n}{n}However, she is better described not as envious, but as a crybaby who wants her own way.{n}{n}For some reason, she is not very shrewd, and always ends up last in the sisters' order, drawing the short straw and crying.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Third Sister, Satan ({p:4:サタン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Satan takes on the role of the ever‐angry class president of the sisters.{n}{n}Diatribes tend to fly out of her mouth in rapid succession, so she is feared by the other sisters.{n}Because of this fear, no one is willing to talk back to her, and she is actually quite lonely.{n}{n}From time to time, she will intentionally do things so that she gets yelled at, but none of her sisters will admonish her for it, making her feel empty.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Fourth Sister, Belphegor ({p:4:ベルフェゴール}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Belphegor is taciturn, assiduous, and the most trusted of the sisters as furniture.{n}{n}However, that is partly because of her demonic desire to turn her masters into lazy pigs.{n}In that sense, she could probably be called the most demon‐like of all the sisters.{n}{n}Her flaw is that she is {i}too{/i} serious. Conversely, she is not used to being treated with kindness.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Fifth Sister, Mammon ({p:4:マモン}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Mammon is extraordinarily quick to take what she wants, and she never holds back, not even for her sisters.{n}{n}Her motto is to be greedy and have things all to herself. For this reason, most arguments between the sisters are sparked and instigated by her.{n}{n}However, among the sisters, she is the most honest about her own emotions, and the most devoted to trying to please the opposite sex.{n}{n}Greedy but a hard worker, she will spare no effort to have a permanent monopoly on someone's affection.

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Sixth Sister, Beelzebub ({p:4:ベルゼブブ}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}Beelzebub is the gourmet of the sisters and is known for being a big and picky eater.{n}{n}Her personality is similar to Mammon's, and they often vie to beat each other to the prize.{n}{n}She's also always talking about food, which makes her a calming influence among the sisters.{n}{n}However, she also has a disturbing desire to kidnap pretty boys and store them in the food cellar...

Seven Sisters of Purgatory{n}Seventh Sister, Asmodeus ({p:4:アスモデウス}){n}{n}Advanced‐level furniture created by {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}As the youngest of the sisters, Asmodeus is doted upon by everyone.{n}This might be why she alone is kept out of the way when the conversation turns a little saucy.{n}{n}In the hopes that her older sisters will accept her as an adult, she is constantly on the lookout for a boyfriend.{n}{n}However, she sets her sights too high, and spends her days fantasizing about the prince who will never come.

Ushiromiya Battler ({p:4:右代宮　戦人}){n}{n}The son of Rudolf and his first wife, Asumu.{n}Turned against his father six years ago when he married a second wife immediately after Asumu passed on.{n}He went to live with his grandparents on his mother's side.{n}However, both of these grandparents passed away, and he has now returned to the Ushiromiya family after six years.{n}{n}This family conference is a chance for him to renew his friendship with his cousins after a six‐year gap.
Ushiromiya Battler ({p:4:右代宮　戦人}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in a guest room.{n}{n}Furudo Erika did not perform a sufficiently detailed investigation, so the details of the cause of death are unknown.

Ushiromiya Eva ({p:4:右代宮　絵羽}){n}{n}Kinzo's second child.{n}Hostile towards her brother Krauss and opposes him in almost everything, from issues dealing with the family fortune to the question of who will succeed the family headship.{n}{n}Normally, she would have lost her place in the Ushiromiya register upon her marriage, but she managed to forcibly overcome this by having her husband take her family name.
Ushiromiya Eva ({p:4:右代宮　絵羽}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the VIP room.{n}{n}Furudo Erika did not perform a sufficiently detailed investigation, so the details of the cause of death are unknown.

Ushiromiya Eva ({p:4:右代宮　絵羽}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the VIP room.{n}{n}A blade had been used to cut her head clean off.{n}{n}The most perfect kind of corpse, rendering a mistaken autopsy impossible while also being completely identifiable.

Ronoue Genji ({p:4:呂ノ上　源氏}){n}{n}Head servant, leading all the other servants who work for the Ushiromiya family.{n}Has served Kinzo longer than any other, and has earned his greatest trust.{n}{n}Since he serves Kinzo directly, Krauss and Natsuhi think of him as Kinzo's spy.

Ushiromiya George ({p:4:右代宮　譲治}){n}{n}Eva and Hideyoshi's son.{n}An affable young man liked by everyone in the family.{n}He is currently studying as an assistant for his father's company, and it seems he dreams of making it on his own one day.{n}{n}The oldest of the four cousins, he acts as their leader and arbitrator.

Gohda Toshiro ({p:4:郷田　俊朗}){n}{n}Servant employed as a chef.{n}While he hasn't served the family long, he has a polished talent for entertaining guests, cultivated through his previous jobs, and is highly regarded as a servant.{n}{n}Since he was hired by Krauss and his wife, he is more trusted than those servants who have served the family longer and who are thought of as Kinzo's spies.

Ushiromiya Hideyoshi ({p:4:右代宮　秀吉}){n}{n}Eva's husband.{n}Took his wife's name upon their marriage and was welcomed into the Ushiromiya family.{n}Therefore, he does not possess the spiteful Ushiromiya genes, and his bright smile is very refreshing at the family conferences.{n}{n}He started his business from scratch, and now works as the president of a company operating medium‐sized restaurant chains.{n}Apparently business is soaring and things are going extremely well.

Ushiromiya Jessica ({p:4:右代宮　朱志香}){n}{n}Krauss and Natsuhi's daughter.{n}In the absence of any irregularities, it is thought that she will eventually inherit the headship of the Ushiromiya family (or rather, her husband will). However, she seems to have no interest in all of this.{n}{n}Born with weak bronchi, and sometimes assailed by sudden asthma attacks.

Kanon ({p:4:嘉音}){n}{n}A young servant.{n}Performs his duties silently and diligently, but due to his unsociable nature, he is not so highly regarded as a servant.{n}{n}There are several other servants with the “on” ({p:4:音}) character in their pseudonyms.{n}He and Shannon just happened to be the ones on duty that day.

Ushiromiya Kinzo ({p:4:右代宮　金蔵}){n}{n}The aged head of the Ushiromiya family.{n}He has already passed away, but Krauss and Natsuhi's locked-room illusion is making it look as though he is still alive.{n}{n}Therefore, there is no longer any need to include him in the number of people on the island.{n}{n}Without him, the number of people on the island drops from 18 to 17.{n}However, the number returns to 18 after welcoming in the guest known as Erika.

Ushiromiya Kyrie ({p:4:右代宮　霧江}){n}{n}Rudolf's second wife.{n}They had been business partners for a considerable length of time before the passing of his first wife, at which time she openly took the position.{n}{n}Served as Rudolf's right hand in several shady pieces of business, guiding them to success.{n}Quick‐thinking and deeply trusted by her husband.
Ushiromiya Kyrie ({p:4:右代宮　霧江}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in Krauss's study.{n}{n}Furudo Erika did not perform a sufficiently detailed investigation, so the details of the cause of death are unknown.

Ushiromiya Kyrie ({p:4:右代宮　霧江}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in Krauss's study.{n}{n}A blade had been used to cut her head clean off.{n}{n}The most perfect kind of corpse, rendering a mistaken autopsy impossible while also being completely identifiable.

Ushiromiya Krauss ({p:4:右代宮　蔵臼}){n}{n}Kinzo's first child.{n}Leads the family conference, as the eldest of the four siblings.{n}{n}However, the other siblings suspect that he plans to claim the entire family fortune for himself, and the antagonism between him and the others grows increasingly severe.{n}{n}A real estate investor, he has put a vast amount of money into the development of a resort.{n}However, his results have been harshly criticized.

Kumasawa Chiyo ({p:4:熊沢　チヨ}){n}{n}This elderly woman is a part‐timer who has served the family for a great many years, despite quitting her job several times along the way.{n}{n}Shrewd and more than competent when it comes to performing her duties, but because of her chattiness and love of rumors, she is not highly regarded as a servant.

Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}){n}{n}Rosa's daughter. Her father's identity is unknown.{n}She can't shake off the habit of speaking like a young child, which often earns her a scolding.{n}{n}She has no interest in studying or making friends, but is very interested in things concerning the occult and black magic, and thanks to her excellent powers of memorization, she knows all kinds of obscure trivia.
Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the parlor.{n}{n}Furudo Erika did not perform a sufficiently detailed investigation, so the details of the cause of death are unknown.

Ushiromiya Maria ({p:4:右代宮　真里亞}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the parlor.{n}{n}A blade had been used to cut her head clean off.{n}{n}The most perfect kind of corpse, rendering a mistaken autopsy impossible while also being completely identifiable.

Nanjo Terumasa ({p:4:南條　輝正}){n}{n}Kinzo's attending physician and long‐time friend.{n}Once ran a hospital on Niijima, but turned it over to his son, and now enjoys his old age in peace.{n}{n}One of the very few people that Kinzo trusts, now that he is held captive by an unrelenting suspicion of others.{n}Big‐hearted by nature, he has maintained a long friendship with Kinzo, unperturbed by his tendency to fly into a rage at the slightest provocation.

Ushiromiya Natsuhi ({p:4:右代宮　夏妃}){n}{n}Krauss's wife.{n}Manages the household of the Ushiromiya head family in place of her husband, who takes little interest.{n}For this family conference, again, she was the one who took charge of making all the preparations and arrangements.{n}{n}Possesses a strong sense of responsibility and a great deal of pride.{n}However, neither her husband nor his siblings understand her very well, so her position is far from enviable.
Ushiromiya Natsuhi ({p:4:右代宮　夏妃}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in her own room.{n}{n}Furudo Erika did not perform a sufficiently detailed investigation, so the details of the cause of death are unknown.

Ushiromiya Natsuhi ({p:4:右代宮　夏妃}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in her own room.{n}{n}A blade had been used to cut her head clean off.{n}{n}The most perfect kind of corpse, rendering a mistaken autopsy impossible while also being completely identifiable.

Ushiromiya Rosa ({p:4:右代宮　楼座}){n}{n}Kinzo's fourth child.{n}By far the youngest of the four siblings.{n}It seems that this gives her a weaker position at the family conference.{n}{n}She manages a design company, but she has yet to start taking it seriously, and its financial situation is far from favorable.
Ushiromiya Rosa ({p:4:右代宮　楼座}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the parlor.{n}{n}Furudo Erika did not perform a sufficiently detailed investigation, so the details of the cause of death are unknown.

Ushiromiya Rosa ({p:4:右代宮　楼座}){n}{n}Corpse discovered in the parlor.{n}{n}A blade had been used to cut her head clean off.{n}{n}The most perfect kind of corpse, rendering a mistaken autopsy impossible while also being completely identifiable.

Ushiromiya Rudolf ({p:4:右代宮　留弗夫}){n}{n}Kinzo's third child.{n}Along with his sister, Eva, he intends to make his voice heard during the family conference to prevent their elder sibling, Krauss, from keeping all of their father's wealth for himself.{n}{n}Lost his former wife, Asumu ({p:4:明日夢}), six years ago, and married his current wife, Kyrie, straight after that.

Shannon ({p:4:紗音}){n}{n}A young but experienced servant.{n}She's normally calm and performs her job flawlessly, but she messes up when she gets nervous.{n}{n}Furthermore, “Shannon” is nothing more than a pseudonym that she uses when on duty, not her real name.

Furudo Erika ({p:4:古戸　ヱリカ}){n}{n}Fell from the pleasure boat “Eternal Maid II” mid-cruise in the waters near Rokkenjima.{n}{n}She washed up on Rokkenjima on October 4th, 1986.{n}The Ushiromiya family welcomed her as a guest.{n}{n}She managed to drift to the island unharmed thanks to several miracles, including the life jacket she was wearing.

Furudo Erika ({p:4:古戸　ヱリカ}){n}{n}Fell from a pleasure boat and currently missing.{n}{n}Due to the Rokkenjima Explosion accident that occurred shortly after, her own accident was lost to history...{n}{n}Her family argues that she might have drifted to Rokkenjima and gotten involved in the accident, but no evidence indicating her presence on the island has been found at the scene.{n}{n}Forgers who learn of her fall from the boat often theorize that she drifted onto Rokkenjima and add her into the witch illusion...

{f:5}Bernkastel{/f} ({p:4:ベルンカステル}){n}{n}With the victory of the {y:0}Human{/y}{n:0}human{/n} side, she should have achieved victory as well, but she seems unable to accept it.{n}{n}It appears that she is less concerned with who actually wins and cares more about how brutal an end might be reached.{n}{n}Therefore, hostile towards {f:5}Battler{/f} as he tries to end this peacefully, she attempts to use Erika to ruin this final game...

Dlanor A. Knox ({p:4:ドラノール・Ａ・ノックス}){n}{n}A member of Eiserne Jungfrau, the Seventh District Repentance Enforcement Agency of the Great Court of Heaven.{n}Chief Inquisitor. Ranked Archbishop, First Class.{n}Goes by the name “Dlanor of the Ten Wedges” or “Death Sentence Dlanor”.{n}{n}She gets the name “Death Sentence” because, though Inquisitors normally judge their targets to determine whether they deserve the death penalty or not, Dlanor, as the Chief Inquisitor, is only dispatched after a case has been vigorously inspected by the Great Court. Therefore, the very act of dispatching her is equivalent to a death sentence.{n}{n}Her father was a legendary Inquisitor, but he broke the rules and was executed.{n}She was the one who interrogated and executed him.{n}Since that time, she has stopped growing, and both her body and mind remain eternally those of a young girl.{n}It is whispered that her heart also died at that moment, but she does not see it that way.{n}{n}Her primary weapons are the Conceptual Arms “Red Key” and “Blue Key”.{n}They take the form of a longsword and a shortsword.

({p:4:ベアトリーチェ}){n}{n}A new witch reborn from the rules.{n}She has not lived a thousand years, and her behavior is vastly different from how it once was.{n}{n}She is a witch who does not even know how to use magic.{n}However, she has no fear of magic circles or spiderwebs.{n}It is almost as though she is just a {y:0}Human{/y}{n:0}human{/n}...{n}{n}She adores Battler and considers it her purpose to devote herself to him.

(the elder) ({p:4:ベアトリーチェ（姉）}){n}{n}A mysterious witch who existed even before the rules.{n}She has the same name as Beato, but she was not given the purpose of devoting herself to Battler.{n}{n}A mere shadow of a witch, sealed away by Kinzo.{n}She spends her days pulling small pranks and clearing away the anti-magic toxin for the sake of her resurrection.{n}{n}Has many things in common with the evil spirits of Akujikijima, such as a fear of spiderwebs.{n}{n}She was the one who gave Shannon the golden butterfly brooch.

{f:5}Lambdadelta{/f} ({p:4:ラムダデルタ}){n}{n}Because the end of the game has been assured with the victory of the {y:0}Human{/y}{n:0}human{/n} side, she no longer stands in opposition to anyone.{n}{n}As a previous Game Master, she also knows the truth, and has taken a position of non-interference.{n}{n}Now, she simply acts as an spectator, enjoying her beloved Bern's contorted expressions...

({p:4:ワルギリア}){n}{n}Retired Endless Witch, and {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s master.{n}Made proper use of the Endless Magic, and dedicated her life to the happiness and smiles of people.{n}{n}Taught {f:5}Beatrice{/f} the Endless Magic, and retired believing that {f:5}Beatrice{/f} would devote herself to people in the same way.{n}{n}As well as being {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s master, she was also the consulting mage of {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s old home.{n}For this reason, {f:5}Virgilia{/f} interacted with her in the manner of a servant.{n}It is said that this was responsible for causing {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s egotism and excesses.

Ronove ({p:4:ロノウェ}){n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons. Serves a master in exchange for various forms of compensation.{n}Presently has a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f} as her butler (head furniture).{n}{n}Has multiple underlings trained in housekeeping, and he himself is extremely capable as a butler.{n}{n}Employing him has become a kind of status in the high society of witches. Furthermore, the cookies he bakes are superb, and witches will often line up to demand them.{n}{n}Should possess enormous magical power, but as he always shows deference to his master, his power level is an unknown quantity.

Gaap ({p:4:ガァプ}){n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons. She is also {f:5}Beatrice{/f}'s friend.{n}Grants the power of teleportation as the mage requests it.{n}{n}She uses this wonderful power only for pranks.{n}Her favorite trick is hiding keys and bags on busy mornings.{n}{n}However, this power of hers is an ultimate weapon that risks delivering the lethal blow to a locked‐room mystery.{n}Her queen‐bee‐like strikes would probably penetrate all famous detectives, and make them surrender.

The goats{n}{n}Low‐level furniture who wait on {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}They are many in number, but have no individuality, and rarely speak. They faithfully obey their master's orders.{n}{n}Closer in sensibility to animals than humans, they are surprisingly stupid, and occasionally get their orders wrong.{n}By nature, they have huge bodies like minotaurs, and possess incredible superhuman strength.{n}{n}They're low‐level as furniture, but the ability to summon them inexhaustibly is extremely useful.

Furudo {f:5}Erika{/f} ({p:4:古戸　ヱリカ}){n}{n}The Witch of Truth (temporarily).{n}She is also a detective and calls herself an intellectual rapist.{n}{n}Participates in Battler's game as the {y:0}Human{/y}{n:0}human{/n} side player.{n}{n}She possesses numerous skills that qualify her to call herself a detective, and these can even be elevated to the level of red truth when acknowledged by her master, {f:5}Bernkastel{/f}.{n}{n}Whether she wins or loses, this will be the last game, and there will be no further use for her.

Gertrude ({p:4:ガートルード}){n}{n}A member of Eiserne Jungfrau, the Seventh District Repentance Enforcement Agency of the Great Court of Heaven.{n}Senior Assistant Inquisitor. Ranked Minister, First Class.{n}{n}As an Assistant Inquisitor, she is tasked with aiding during interrogations and hearings.{n}{n}In practice, execution ends up being the primary focus of most missions, and so she is usually assigned the job of using barriers to block the target's means of escape.{n}{n}On duty, she is calm, flawless, expressionless, and emotionless; however, in truth, she is quite compassionate and is loved by many of her juniors.{n}{n}She has already passed the exam to become a full Inquisitor and was offered a position in a different district, but she refused.{n}She continues to serve alongside Dlanor, to whom she owes a great debt, waiting for a reassignment under her.{n}Therefore, though she is an assistant, she is treated as an Inquisitor (Archbishop, Third Class).

Cornelia ({p:4:コーネリア}){n}{n}A member of Eiserne Jungfrau, the Seventh District Repentance Enforcement Agency of the Great Court of Heaven.{n}Assistant Inquisitor, ranked Minister, Third Class.{n}{n}She has obtained high grades in academic exercises, but this is her first time on the job.{n}She possesses a strong sense of justice, and is currently cramming for exams to become an Inquisitor like Dlanor.{n}Her current goal is to become more like the veteran assistant, Gertrude.{n}{n}She actually has a zealous personality, but she pretends to be emotionless in imitation of Gertrude.{n}{n}She is too innocent and pure for one connected to heresy hearings, and she knows nothing of the dirty jobs and dark side of the profession.{n}{n}Gertrude intentionally selected her for this mission, which stinks of Senate conspiracy.{n}She did this to give Cornelia a chance to ask herself whether this sort of job really is the right one for her.

({p:4:バトラ}){n}{n}The Endless Sorcerer and final Game Master.{n}He is the ruler of the game board and the territory lord.{n}{n}To prove that he has won Beato's game, he must take on the position of Game Master.{n}By succeeding in this, his victory will be acknowledged, and Beato's game will reach its end.{n}{n}Because he knows the whole truth, he exists on a higher plane than all others.

Zepar{n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons.{n}Presides over love and tests others through trials.{n}{n}Zepar grants the contractor undying, immeasurable defensive power.{n}This gives the contractor the courage not to dread any of love's wounds.{n}{n}A “hunter” of love who loves to prey upon passive men.{n}{n}Is of a different gender than Furfur.

Furfur{n}{n}One of the 72 Great Demons.{n}Presides over love and tests others through trials.{n}{n}Furfur grants the contractor endless, inexhaustible offensive power.{n}This gives the contractor the courage not to fear any of love's barriers.{n}{n}A “trainer” of love who teaches passive men the taste of flesh.{n}{n}Is of a different gender than Zepar.

Chiester{ruby}forty‐five{rb}45{/ruby} ({p:4:シエスタ４５}){n}{n}A weapon in a contract with {f:5}Beatrice{/f}.{n}{n}45 has an extremely meticulous and timid personality, and is fairly paranoid.{n}For that reason, she compensates well for the weaknesses of 410's slapdash personality when they work as a pair.{n}{n}Cannot bear silence, and even becomes emotionally unstable unless she is constantly being given orders.{n}{n}45 excels in enemy search and being decisive. The sisters' battle power is doubled by her support.
